mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.5%, it triggers a restrictive monetary policy response that increases real interest rates and compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months with CPIAUCSL y/y > 3.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in housing starts (HOUST) and employment (PAYEMS) indicates robust consumer demand that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months meeting both HOUST > 1200 and PAYEMS > 159000, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), tight labor market conditions fuel wage growth and consumer spending, boosting corporate profits and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months with UNRATE < 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals strong manufacturing activity and economic expansion that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months with rising INDPRO, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When annualized GDP growth (GDPC1) exceeds 2.5%, it signals robust economic expansion that boosts corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of quarters with GDPC1 annualized growth > 2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%) and low policy rates (FEDFUNDS < 3.5%) indicate delayed monetary tightening, causing rising real rates and inflation fears that depress equity valuations, yielding negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months meeting CPIAUCSL > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS < 3.5%, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-recession recovery phase (RSAFS growth > 1.0%), rising retail sales support consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months with RSAFS growth > 1.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
